name: Orbit ring
description: A ring of tall serif capitals spins round the speaker's head like a planet's ring. The front half passes in front of the chin in gold, the back half goes behind the head in silver. It whips in with a blur, spins, and spins out round the neck.
when: When a word or a name should circle you: a title, a topic, a short loop of words.
needs: the text of the ring (short, it repeats)
the middle of the ring (about the nose)
the cut time where it starts
a cutout of the speaker (made in the steps)
